summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of Solutions BC's 2003 logo — four figures joined around a centre, over “Solutions BC / SHARED SERVICES”, on teal — replacing the 115 × 149 image from the June 2003 procurement document, which is kept as its download. See package-README.md, reconstruction-details.json and review/comparison.webp.

assets.label: Solutions BC — Figures on teal, 2003
assets.sourceLocator: Revenue Management Project procurement document, PDF page 2 (cover letter dated 27 June 2003)
assets.dateNote: The document’s date, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: Four interlocking grey figures on a teal panel, over “Solutions BC / SHARED SERVICES”: the shared-services organization’s first logo.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied reconstruction: two drawn figure shapes, each repeated turned about, with four circles for heads, and both lines of lettering as custom outlines, after a restored copy of the 2003 logo (overlap 98% for the emblem, 95% and 91% for the two lines). Colours are sampled, not a brand specification; the typeface is not identified.
